tokens.name: rate-bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card and table.

tokens.name: rate-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Primary cards, review containers and spec tables (.rate-card, .rate-spec-group-card).

tokens.name: rate-bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Scoreboard wells, table headers, eyebrow pills and criteria bar tracks.

tokens.name: rate-bg-dark
tokens.usage: Obsidian hero and command sections in both themes; the extension side panel base. Text on it uses rate-fg-on-dark.

tokens.name: rate-bg-dark-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised panels inside obsidian sections (telemetry tiles, battle cards).

tokens.name: rate-border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px structural hairline on cards, pills and table rows.

tokens.name: rate-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border of interactive cards and focused inputs.

tokens.name: rate-border-dark
tokens.usage: Hairline on rate-bg-dark sections in both themes.

tokens.name: rate-fg-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, product titles and spec values on rate-bg-canvas, rate-bg-surface and rate-bg-elevated.

tokens.name: rate-fg-paragraph
tokens.usage: Long-form body copy and eyebrow text on rate-bg-surface and rate-bg-elevated (source --paragraphColor; dark value from the web's dark sections).

tokens.name: rate-fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Review body copy, spec labels and descriptions on rate-bg-surface and rate-bg-canvas.

tokens.name: rate-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, model_key metadata and captions on rate-bg-surface and rate-bg-canvas. Source pair: on dark rate-bg-canvas and rate-bg-surface it reaches only about 4.1:1 and 3.8:1 and on light rate-bg-elevated about 4.3:1, so keep it to 24px+ or non-essential text on those grounds.

tokens.name: rate-fg-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on rate-bg-dark and rate-bg-dark-elevated in both themes.

tokens.name: rate-fg-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles and captions on rate-bg-dark (homepage hero subtitle).

tokens.name: rate-brand
tokens.usage: Brand focal mark: the red dot, hero highlight border, the active-state glow. A mark, not a text color on light grounds (about 3.7:1 on white); on rate-bg-dark it reads at about 5.1:1.

tokens.name: rate-brand-bg
tokens.usage: Soft brand tint behind a brand-colored chip or callout.

tokens.name: rate-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of brand-colored links and controls.

tokens.name: bs-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, link hover and text-primary. White text on it holds about 4.7:1.

tokens.name: bs-primary-bg-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, focus and active fill.

tokens.name: bs-primary-text-emphasis
tokens.usage: Crimson text that must read on rate-bg-surface (about 6.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: rate-crimson-text
tokens.usage: Crimson link and outline-button text on rate-bg-surface and rate-bg-canvas: bs-primary in light (4.7:1 on white), #ff6b6b in dark (the homepage hero highlight color, about 6:1 on dark rate-bg-surface).

tokens.name: bs-primary-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Light-primary button and badge-primary background.

tokens.name: bs-primary-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Light-primary button border and the 4px focus halo around inputs.

tokens.name: rate-score-user
tokens.usage: Emerald: authentic user score, pros, verified buyer, trust >= 85. A fill and icon color; text uses rate-score-user-ink.

tokens.name: rate-score-user-bg
tokens.usage: User score badge background.

tokens.name: rate-score-user-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the user score badge and 'Review thật' labels on rate-score-user-bg.

tokens.name: rate-score-user-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the user score badge.

tokens.name: rate-score-expert
tokens.usage: Indigo: expert lab score, 5-criteria bars, AI enriched specs. A fill; text uses rate-score-expert-ink.

tokens.name: rate-score-expert-bg
tokens.usage: Expert score badge background.

tokens.name: rate-score-expert-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the expert score badge on rate-score-expert-bg.

tokens.name: rate-score-expert-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the expert score badge.

tokens.name: rate-score-star
tokens.usage: Amber: star icons, moderate seeding watch, minor price volatility. Source pair: about 2.1:1 on white, so a star always sits beside its numeric score.

tokens.name: rate-score-star-bg
tokens.usage: Soft amber tint for caution callouts (DESIGN.md).

tokens.name: rate-score-star-ink
tokens.usage: Star score numerals: #fbbf24 on rate-bg-dark (text-warning in the scoreboard), #d97706 for large numerals on light grounds only (about 3.2:1).

tokens.name: rate-risk-danger
tokens.usage: Rose: seeding spam excluded, cons, fake discount alert. Pair with an icon or word; text on light grounds uses bs-primary-text-emphasis.

tokens.name: rate-risk-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of risk callouts and excluded-review rows.

tokens.name: rate-criteria-from
tokens.usage: Start stop of the criteria fill gradient (indigo, equals rate-score-expert).

tokens.name: rate-criteria-to
tokens.usage: End stop of the criteria fill gradient (emerald, equals rate-score-user).

tokens.name: rate-criteria-track
tokens.usage: Track behind a criteria bar, on light and dark grounds.

tokens.name: bs-success
tokens.usage: Bootstrap 5.3 success: Deal Radar 'genuine deal' badge fill with white text (about 4.5:1).

tokens.name: bs-danger
tokens.usage: Bootstrap 5.3 danger: Deal Radar 'fake sale trap' badge and the VS chip, white text (about 4.5:1).

tokens.name: bs-warning
tokens.usage: Bootstrap 5.3 warning: rank chips in the scoreboard with rate-fg-primary text, and the outline-warning leaderboard button on rate-bg-dark.

tokens.name: bs-warning-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Deal Radar 'price spread' badge background with dark text.

tokens.name: bs-warning-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Deal Radar 'price spread' badge border.

tokens.name: bs-highlight-bg
tokens.usage: Background of <mark> search highlights.

tokens.name: bs-code-color
tokens.usage: Inline code and API identifiers on rate-bg-surface.

tokens.name: form-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of .form-control inputs.

families.sans: Inter, "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Noto Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
